subject: Post-demo: hosting options & purchase route confirmation
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Theo Marshall <theo@novato.ai>, Novato Procurement <procurement@novato.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 18:12:00 +0000
Subject: Post-demo: hosting options & purchase route confirmation

Hi Theo — great demo this morning, thanks again for your time. Quick recap and a few asks so we can align procurement & pricing before you open paperwork: 

Recap (what we covered)
- Pilot: 2-week proof-of-concept on Hosted API with streaming and eval hooks
- Production: Novato expects low-double-digit p99 latency and steady throughput for customer-facing features — you mentioned Dedicated as a preference for production, but wanted to validate cost/commit tradeoffs
- Compliance: SOC 2 + DPA required by procurement

Key asks / next steps
1) Procurement preference: PO (vendor contract) vs corporate card vs marketplace? If PO, who is the procurement contact and vendor onboarding lead?
2) Expected spend profile: pilot budget and anticipated monthly run rate at GA (ballpark helps us size commit/discount scenarios)
3) Timing: target date to have vendor paperwork/SOW ready for your legal/procurement review

What we can provide this week
- Draft SOW and scope of work (simple pilot -> production ramp)
- Hosting options & pricing matrix (Hosted on-demand, Dedicated reserved with commit tiers, Private/VPC pricing notes)
- SOC 2 report + DPA template

Goal: recommend the simplest procurement path that meets your internal rules (fastest to get pilot running) and outline the commercial delta if you move to Dedicated with a commit.

If you confirm procurement preference + expected monthly run rate (pilot vs production), I’ll loop in Laura with a tailored pricing summary and a short SOW for procurement. Karthik will supply a quick perf baseline plan for the pilot.

Thanks — Connor
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: SOW_draft_Novato.pdf (will follow), hosting-pricing-breakdown-connor-20270412.csv (internal)
From: Theo Marshall <theo@novato.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novato Procurement <procurement@novato.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: hosting options & purchase route confirmation

Connor — thanks for the clear recap. A few items from our side: 

1) Procurement route: we prefer a PO under our standard vendor agreement (legal often resists marketplace purchases for anything >$10k/mo). Procurement contact is procurement@novato.ai (I work with Maya Patel there).

2) Spend profile: pilot likely $4–6k total (2–4 weeks). Production estimate: ~40k/mo initially (user-facing features in Q3) with potential to scale.

3) Timing: procurement would like an SOW + pricing spreadsheet to review. Targeting vendor paperwork signed by mid-May if the pricing and SLOs look good.

4) Hosting preference: engineering wants Dedicated for predictable latency in production, but product is open to starting on Hosted for the pilot if the migration path to Dedicated is straight-forward. Please include migration notes.

5) Compliance: please share SOC2 report and your DPA template. We also have a quick security questionnaire — I will loop Maya and the procurement team if needed.

On the pricing note, can you send both: (a) Hosted on-demand estimate for pilot and GA, (b) Dedicated committed pricing for 12-month and 36-month commit options (node counts and discount tiers). Also flag any one-time onboarding fees or minimum purchase requirements.

Thanks — Theo
Theo Marshall
Head of Platform
Novato.ai

Connor / team — looping in the commercial ask and proposing a straightforward path to match Novato's procurement constraints. High-level recommended route: 

Proposal (pilot -> production)
- Pilot (fastest path): Hosted on-demand. No commit, low friction onboarding. Provide a 90-day trial credit for pilot to reduce procurement friction. Estimated pilot cost (usage-based): $4–6k total — we will provide a line-item estimate for request.
- Production (target GA): Dedicated reserved cluster. Recommend a 12-month commitment as primary option with a 36-month option if Novato wants deeper discounts. Suggested sizing: 3 x cGPU nodes to meet your latency/throughput targets; we can firm node sizing after Karthik's perf baseline.

Commercials (ballpark)
- Hosted on-demand (production at 40k/mo run rate): estimated $0.XX per 1k tokens (we will send the break down) — higher per-unit cost vs Dedicated.
- Dedicated 12-month commit (3 nodes): ~20–30% discount vs hosted run-rate; 36-month commit: ~35–45% discount. Exact figures depend on node sizing and reserved capacity level.
- One-time onboarding: standard setup fee (waivable in some enterprise packages) — note it in the SOW and we can negotiate.

Compliance & paperwork
- We will attach SOC 2 (type II) and our standard DPA. I’ll also include a short SOW template that maps to your pilot then production ramp.

Next steps we recommend this week
1) Connor: send SOW + pilot scope + SOC2/DPA to procurement@novato.ai.
2) Karthik: run a short perf baseline plan and confirm node sizing options (target by EOD Thu).
3) Laura: I will assemble two commercial options (Hosted pilot -> Dedicated 12m commit; and Hosted-only on-demand for GA) with line-item pricing and an annex for migration steps.

Target milestones
- SOW to procurement: within 48 hours
- Commercial summary to Novato: by Fri, Apr 16
- Procurement feedback / PO intent: target May 15

Attachments: SOW_draft_Novato.pdf (SOW template), hosting-pricing-breakdown-connor-20270412.csv (pricing line items)

Happy to refine — Laura
Laura Bennett
Commercial Lead, Americas
Redwood Inference
